a7a892a502ce4b69145c15e4b10f0b309e25f17f.sql:
SELECT
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    sc.structstate AS structural_condition,
    s.presstat AS status,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.envhaz = 'High' THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone'
        ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone'
    END AS risk_category
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanconservation sc ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
WHERE 
    s.envhaz = 'High';

6318c5377a465e37899776cba47430aaf5b5d3c0.sql:
SELECT
    sp.flowsoft AS processing_software,
    sp.flowstage AS processing_stage,
    AVG(sp.flowhrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
    AVG(sp.proccpu) AS avg_cpu_usage_percent,
    AVG(sp.procgpu) AS avg_gpu_usage_percent,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_data_size_gb,
    AVG((sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) AS avg_efficiency_value,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG((sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
        WHEN AVG((sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
        ELSE 'Needs Optimization'
    END AS efficiency_status,
    COUNT(*) AS total_workflow_count
FROM
    scanprocessing AS sp
JOIN
    equipment AS eq ON sp.equipref = eq.equipregistry
GROUP BY
    sp.flowsoft, sp.flowstage;

35b8d6008d1ae53acc7613132b9335327e7d9ee7.sql:
SELECT
    sf.zoneref AS site_code,
    AVG(spc.pointdense) AS avg_density_value,
    AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_extraction_value
FROM
    Scanfeatures sf
JOIN
    Scanpointcloud spc
    ON sf.zoneref = spc.arcref
GROUP BY
    sf.zoneref;

e7c97130e8d8af34683849982633294209d38959.sql:
SELECT 
    e.equipregistry AS equipment_id,
    AVG(sp.proccpu * sp.procgpu) AS utilization_value,
    AVG(sp.flowhrs) AS avg_processing_time_hours,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(sp.proccpu * sp.procgpu) < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' 
        WHEN AVG(sp.proccpu * sp.procgpu) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' 
        ELSE 'Needs Optimization' 
    END AS efficiency_ranking,
    CASE 
        WHEN sp.safebak = 'Completed' THEN 'Completed' 
        WHEN sp.safebak = 'In Progress' THEN 'In Progress' 
        ELSE 'Pending' 
    END AS workflow_status,
    CONCAT(e.equipform, ' - ', e.equipdesign, ' - ', e.equipstatus) AS resource_details
FROM 
    equipment e
JOIN 
    scanprocessing sp ON e.equipregistry = sp.equipref
GROUP BY 
    e.equipregistry, sp.safebak, e.equipform, e.equipdesign, e.equipstatus;

c5ac54448b1182f6fd0cb9ba7744d5f5fafdae17.sql:
SELECT 
    s.questregistry AS scan_id,
    p.vesseltag AS project,
    st.zonelabel AS site,
    s.chronotag AS timestamp,
    spc.scanresolmm AS resolution,
    spc.pointdense AS density,
    spc.coverpct AS coverage,
    spc.noisedb AS noise_level
FROM 
    scans s
JOIN 
    projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
JOIN 
    sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
JOIN 
    scanpointcloud spc ON s.arcref = spc.arcref
WHERE 
    spc.noisedb < 1.5;

a48a11525bb4835abbcedb86dc1d09083e61369d.sql:
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry)) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_params,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    sm.uvmapqual AS mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
GROUP BY 
    s.zonelabel, sm.uvmapqual
ORDER BY 
    high_fidelity_proportion DESC;

494e3f286b80594b3796063345030dfef2daef13.sql:
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_density_value,
    AVG(sf.traitcount * spc.coverpct * ss.aream2) AS avg_extraction_value
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanfeatures sf ON s.zoneregistry = sf.zoneref
JOIN 
    scanpointcloud spc ON s.zoneregistry = spc.arcref
JOIN 
    scanspatial ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.arcref
GROUP BY 
    s.zoneregistry;

167e3d7366ed04128ee2175292c1a278522242b5.sql:
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_designation,
    (CASE 
        WHEN sc.harmassess = 'None' THEN 10
        WHEN sc.harmassess = 'Moderate' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.harmassess = 'Severe' THEN 1
    END) * (
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'Critical' THEN 1
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'High' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'Low' THEN 10
    END) * (
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Stable' THEN 10
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Moderate' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Unstable' THEN 1
    END) AS quality_index
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanconservation sc ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
ORDER BY 
    quality_index DESC;

SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry)) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.facetverts / sm.facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
    sm.uvmapqual AS mesh_quality
FROM 
    scanmesh sm
JOIN 
    sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY 
    s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, sm.uvmapqual
ORDER BY 
    site_code DESC;

79b83e43f62b80bff17431077934766e1db22b39.sql:
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.facetverts / sm.facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
    m.mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
JOIN 
    (SELECT zoneref, 'High Quality' AS mesh_quality FROM scanmesh WHERE uvmapqual = 'High'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT zoneref, 'Standard Quality' AS mesh_quality FROM scanmesh WHERE uvmapqual <> 'High') m
ON 
    s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
GROUP BY 
    s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, m.mesh_quality
ORDER BY 
    site_code DESC;

8946916f5c8a244a2754a47db1cfaff01d3eba6d.sql:
SELECT 
    se.zoneref AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    AVG(
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 100
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 10 AND 40 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.ambictemp < 20 THEN 100 - (20 - se.ambictemp) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.ambictemp - 30) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.4
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 40 AND 60 THEN 100
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 80 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.humepct < 40 THEN 100 - (40 - se.humepct) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.humepct - 60) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 
                    100 - (50000 - se.illumelux) * 0.2
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
    ) AS average_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    scanenvironment se
JOIN 
    sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY 
    se.zoneref, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY 
    average_scanning_suitability DESC;

    p.arcregistry AS project_id,

    sr.errvalmm AS error_value,

    CASE 
        WHEN (sr.logaccumm / sr.errvalmm) > 0.8 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (sr.logaccumm / sr.errvalmm) BETWEEN 0.5 AND 0.8 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
FROM 
    scanregistration AS sr
JOIN 
    projects AS p ON sr.arcref = p.arcregistry;

WITH MeshMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.zoneref,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(CAST(sm.facetverts AS FLOAT) / sm.facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
        AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
        sm.uvmapqual AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh AS sm
    GROUP BY 
        sm.zoneref, sm.uvmapqual
),
SiteInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneregistry, 
        s.zonelabel
    FROM 
        sites AS s
)
SELECT 
    si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    si.zonelabel AS site_name,
    mm.total_mesh_count,
    mm.high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    ROUND((mm.high_fidelity_mesh_count * 100.0 / mm.total_mesh_count), 2) AS high_fidelity_proportion_percent,
    mm.avg_complexity_ratio,
    mm.avg_resolution_mm,
    mm.avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
    mm.mesh_quality
FROM 
    MeshMetrics AS mm
JOIN 
    SiteInfo AS si ON mm.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
ORDER BY 
    site_code DESC;

WITH RankedScans AS (
    SELECT 
        arcref, 
        cloudregistry, 
        scanresolmm, 
        coverpct, 
        noisedb, 
        (
            (10.0 / scanresolmm) ^ 1.5 
            * (coverpct / 100.0) 
            * (1 - (noisedb / 30.0)) ^ 2
        ) AS sqs, 
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arcref ORDER BY (
            (10.0 / scanresolmm) ^ 1.5 
            * (coverpct / 100.0) 
            * (1 - (noisedb / 30.0)) ^ 2
        ) DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        scanpointcloud
)
SELECT 
    arcref, 
    cloudregistry, 
    scanresolmm, 
    coverpct, 
    noisedb, 
    sqs
FROM 
    RankedScans
WHERE 
    rank > 1;

a508d7a200c800cc62cf0ec52ee5d87df7400db9.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment AS se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (sa.avg_temperature + sa.avg_humidity + sa.avg_illumination) / 3) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        SiteAverages AS sa
),
EnvironmentalConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN -5 AND 5 THEN 'Cold' 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN 6 AND 15 THEN 'Cool' 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN 16 AND 25 THEN 'Mild' 
            ELSE 'Hot' 
        END AS temperature_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_humidity < 30 THEN 'Dry' 
            WHEN ss.avg_humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 'Moderate' 
            ELSE 'Humid' 
        END AS humidity_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_illumination < 10000 THEN 'Low Light' 
            WHEN ss.avg_illumination BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000 THEN 'Moderate Light' 
            ELSE 'High Light' 
        END AS illumination_category
    FROM 
        SiteAverages AS ss
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    ec.temperature_category,
    ec.humidity_category,
    ec.illumination_category
FROM 
    sites AS s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages AS sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    SiteSuitability AS ss ON sa.site_code = ss.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    EnvironmentalConditions AS ec ON sa.site_code = ec.site_code
ORDER BY 
    s.zonelabel;

ddad1e9dc00a9b1d97275c3925e538d78bf2a1b2.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.zoneref AS site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sc.curerank) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        scanconservation sc
),
EnvironmentalConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS environmental_condition
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    ec.environmental_condition
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    EnvironmentalConditions ec ON s.zoneregistry = ec.site_code;

d59ceb2dc72984a1e2ce83e65c5e1266546b9214.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (

            WHEN (AVG(se.ambictemp) + AVG(se.humepct) + AVG(se.illumelux)) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS eccs_category
    FROM

        se.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,

    sa.avg_illumination,

    sec.eccs_category
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.site_code
JOIN 
    SiteECC sec ON s.zoneregistry = sec.site_code;

bf11d0b4241768ef6c0cfc08750397e6522e17d4.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temp,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (

        sa.zoneref,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (sa.avg_temp + sa.avg_humidity + sa.avg_illumination) / 3) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM SiteAverages sa
),
SiteECCS AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN s.envhaz = 'Low' THEN 'Good'
            WHEN s.envhaz = 'Medium' THEN 'Fair'
            WHEN s.envhaz = 'High' THEN 'Poor'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS eccs_category
    FROM sites s
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temp AS average_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity AS average_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination AS average_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile AS suitability_quartile,
    se.eccs_category AS environmental_condition
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.zoneref
JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.zoneref
JOIN 
    SiteECCS se ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneregistry;

WITH SiteDensity AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(spc.pointdense) AS avg_density
    FROM 
        scanfeatures sf
    JOIN 
        scanpointcloud spc ON sf.zoneref = spc.arcref
    GROUP BY 
        sf.zoneref
),
ExtractionEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_extraction
    FROM 
        scanfeatures sf
    GROUP BY 
        sf.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    sd.site_code,
    sd.avg_density AS avg_density_value,
    ee.avg_extraction AS avg_extraction_value
FROM 
    SiteDensity sd
JOIN 
    ExtractionEfficiency ee ON sd.site_code = ee.site_code;

WITH WorkflowEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        flowsoft AS processing_software,
        flowstage AS processing_stage,
        AVG(flowhrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
        AVG(proccpu) AS avg_cpu_usage,
        AVG(procgpu) AS avg_gpu_usage,
        AVG(remaingb) AS avg_data_size_gb,
        (AVG(flowhrs) / NULLIF(AVG(remaingb), 0)) AS efficiency_value,
        COUNT(*) AS total_workflows
    FROM scanprocessing
    GROUP BY flowsoft, flowstage
),
EfficiencyStatus AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE 
            WHEN efficiency_value > 1 THEN 'Bottleneck'
            ELSE 'Not a Bottleneck'
        END AS efficiency_status
    FROM WorkflowEfficiency
)
SELECT 
    processing_software,
    processing_stage,
    avg_processing_hours,
    avg_cpu_usage,
    avg_gpu_usage,
    avg_data_size_gb,
    efficiency_value,
    efficiency_status,
    total_workflows
FROM EfficiencyStatus;

e42bdfc7f291ceef0e6d905e448199cc2a9fc9a4.sql:
WITH eccs AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg(esi) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS avg_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se,
        LATERAL (
            SELECT 
                (
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 OR se.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 75
                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 OR se.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 75
                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.illumelux BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 75
                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                            WHEN se.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Disconnected' THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.photomap = '90%' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.photomap = '80%' THEN 80
                            WHEN se.photomap = '60%' THEN 60
                            ELSE 40
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.imgcount > 500 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 75
                            WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    )
                ) AS esi
        ) esi_calc
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
) 
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    eccs.avg_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    eccs ON s.zoneregistry = eccs.zoneref;

5a4e20d0429841068b41e62290f5918e5ff7cf04.sql:
WITH equipment_utilization AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.equipref AS equipment_id,
        (sp.flowhrs * (sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2.0 / (sp.remaingb * 10 * LN(sm.facetverts + 10000))) AS utilization_value,
        sp.flowhrs AS average_processing_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN (sp.flowhrs * (sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2.0 / (sp.remaingb * 10 * LN(sm.facetverts + 10000))) < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' 
            WHEN (sp.flowhrs * (sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2.0 / (sp.remaingb * 10 * LN(sm.facetverts + 10000))) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' 
            ELSE 'Needs Optimization' 
        END AS efficiency_ranking,
        sp.flowstage AS workflow_status,
        se.ambictemp AS resource_details
    FROM 
        scanprocessing AS sp
    JOIN 
        scanmesh AS sm ON sp.equipref = sm.equipref
    JOIN 
        scanenvironment AS se ON sp.equipref = se.equipref
) 
SELECT 
    equipment_id,
    utilization_value,
    average_processing_time,
    efficiency_ranking,
    workflow_status,
    resource_details
FROM 
    equipment_utilization;

WITH high_fidelity_mesh AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.zoneref AS site_code,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
        AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        -- Assuming Mesh Quality is derived from uvmapqual
        ARRAY_AGG(sm.uvmapqual) AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh AS sm
    JOIN 
        sites AS s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY 
        sm.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    hfm.site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    hfm.total_mesh_count,
    hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count * 100.0 / hfm.total_mesh_count) AS proportion_high_fidelity,
    hfm.avg_geometric_accuracy,
    hfm.avg_resolution_mm,
    hfm.mesh_quality
FROM 
    high_fidelity_mesh AS hfm
JOIN 
    sites AS s ON hfm.site_code = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY 
    proportion_high_fidelity DESC;

5093d4eec1bae54dbc9c5897ecc24d9017bf3d44.sql:
WITH mesh_quality AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.zoneref,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(facetverts / facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
        AVG(facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        AVG(geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(facetresmm) < 1.0 AND AVG(geomdeltamm) < 0.1 THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN AVG(facetresmm) < 2.0 AND AVG(geomdeltamm) < 0.5 THEN 'High'
            WHEN AVG(facetresmm) < 5.0 AND AVG(geomdeltamm) < 1.0 THEN 'Standard'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh sm
    GROUP BY 
        sm.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    mq.total_mesh_count,
    mq.high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (mq.high_fidelity_mesh_count * 100.0 / mq.total_mesh_count) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    mq.avg_complexity_ratio,
    mq.avg_resolution_mm,
    mq.avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
    mq.mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    mesh_quality mq ON s.zoneregistry = mq.zoneref
ORDER BY 
    mq.mesh_quality DESC;

d4719fc665773f55b08d7db1af7d5d88f162354f.sql:
WITH site_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temp,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment AS se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
site_quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.site_code,
        sa.avg_temp,
        sa.avg_humidity,
        sa.avg_illumination,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (sa.avg_temp + sa.avg_humidity + sa.avg_illumination) / 3) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        site_avg AS sa
),
env_conditions AS (
    SELECT 
        sq.site_code,
        sq.avg_temp,
        sq.avg_humidity,
        sq.avg_illumination,
        sq.suitability_quartile,
        CASE 
            WHEN (sq.avg_temp + sq.avg_humidity + sq.avg_illumination) / 3 > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN (sq.avg_temp + sq.avg_humidity + sq.avg_illumination) / 3 BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN (sq.avg_temp + sq.avg_humidity + sq.avg_illumination) / 3 BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS env_condition
    FROM 
        site_quartiles AS sq
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    ec.avg_temp AS avg_temperature,
    ec.avg_humidity,
    ec.avg_illumination,
    ec.suitability_quartile,
    ec.env_condition
FROM 
    sites AS s
JOIN 
    env_conditions AS ec ON s.zoneregistry = ec.site_code;

WITH site_scan_suitability AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.zoneregistry AS location_id,
        t1.zonelabel AS location_name,
        AVG(
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 30000 AND 50000 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 10000 AND 30000 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.linkstatus = 'Disconnected' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '90%' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '60%' THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '80%' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) / 7 AS average_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        sites AS t1
    JOIN 
        scanenvironment AS t2 ON t1.zoneregistry = t2.zoneref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.zoneregistry, t1.zonelabel
)
SELECT 
    location_id,
    location_name,
    average_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    site_scan_suitability
ORDER BY 
    average_scanning_suitability DESC;

WITH sqs AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        (
            (10 / scanresolmm) ^ 1.5
        ) * (
            (coverpct / 100)
        ) * (
            (1 - (noisedb / 30)) ^ 2
        ) AS sqs
    FROM scanpointcloud
),
ranked_sqs AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arcref ORDER BY sqs DESC) as sqs_rank
    FROM sqs
)
SELECT 
    cloudregistry
FROM ranked_sqs
WHERE sqs_rank > 1;

b9000a22851023ca56cca276837fd29a7e2d0d2a.sql:
WITH sqs AS (
  SELECT 
    spc.arcref, 
    (coverpct * (100 - noisedb)) AS sqs,
    s.questregistry
  FROM 
    scanpointcloud AS spc
    JOIN scans AS s ON spc.arcref = s.arcref
)
SELECT 
  arcref, 
  MAX(sqs) AS max_sqs, 
  questregistry
FROM 
  sqs
GROUP BY 
  arcref, questregistry;
